description: Explicit-device loading leaves deferred mode and pending reads active when module loading or its flush raises.
trigger: An eligible module uses deferred loading in Model._load_single and module.load or end_deferred_load raises, followed by reuse of the same configuration/collection.
expected_behavior: Abort deferred state on failure so subsequent tensor reads or retries start from a clean lifecycle state.
actual_behavior: Unlike autosplit, _load_single has no exception handler calling abort_deferred_load. A retry fails the begin_deferred_load assertion; intervening get_tensor calls may queue instead of reading.

introductions.rationale: 140 adds begin/end deferral without the abort handler used by autosplit.

verification.description: Compared _load_single with autosplit failure handling and collection deferred-state transitions.
verification.limits: No induced load failure, OOM, retry or native execution; conditional reuse consequence only.

affected_revisions.limits: 140 source observation only; no descendant range asserted.
